judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale:
No-claim row. The element is the line-art icon of three staff figures (sj__stat-team.svg, alt="") inside a circle above the statistic "5,652" and its caption "Total Staff - 2025" in the hospital's stats section. The crop and the screenshot show a purely illustrative pictogram; the number and the caption next to it carry all the information, so the icon is decorative and a null alt that lets assistive technology ignore it is the correct treatment under 1.1.1 (technique H67, Understanding 1.1.1 Situation F). I looked for a reason it could fail anyway (the icon conveying something the text does not, being a control, or being the only label of the figure) and found none. The live HTML fetched with curl has the same markup (img.stats__icon, alt="", followed by the odometer number and the

Total Staff - 2025

caption), matching the snapshot, so the capture does not differ in a way that matters. The element meets 1.1.1, so Rampa was right to report nothing.
